# The compile-time options of SQLite, one per line, read by build.ps1 (Windows) and build.sh (Linux and macOS).
# Read from https://sqlite.org/compile.html: double-quoted strings are identifiers only, memory statistics are off, and
# column metadata is on because Microsoft.Data.Sqlite asks for it.
SQLITE_THREADSAFE=1
SQLITE_DQS=0
SQLITE_DEFAULT_MEMSTATUS=0
SQLITE_ENABLE_COLUMN_METADATA=1
